sourceBrief: Create a memorable AutoPromote welcome film and social campaign from an idea alone, with no recorded footage. Show imagination becoming finished work, rather than a feature list.
prompt: An enormous curling tsunami wave, a towering dark blue wall of water, dominates almost the entire picture. At its base one tiny intact white folded paper boat floats, less than five percent of the frame. Wide dramatic storm scene, steep giant wave above fragile paper, white sea spray, warm amber rim light, sharp realistic turbulent water, cinematic commercial photography.
